svg.text: refundFailedDeposit(requestId) — required state, all status values, and every outcome
PrivacyPortal.sol:583-601 · status writers in PrivacyPortal.sol / PodERC20.sol · coti-contracts 8a0c4928
1 · The two gates inside the function (in execution order)
Permissionless. Funds always go to escrow.user.
Note: DepositEscrowStatus.Failed is accepted by gate 1 but is never written anywhere in PrivacyPortal.sol — in practice gate 1 means “escrow is Pending”.
2 · Portal side — DepositEscrowStatus (IPrivacyPortal.sol:23-31) · writers in PrivacyPortal.sol
stays Pending after a SUCCESSFUL mint too — nothing ever updates the escrow on mint success
refund writers: refundFailedDeposit (needs pToken SystemFailed) · adminRefundPendingDeposit (DEFAULT_ADMIN, portal paused, pToken status ≠ Success)
No transition Pending → Failed exists, and there is no path back from Refunded.
3 · pToken side — IPodERC20.RequestStatus (IPodERC20.sol:13-21) · writers in PodERC20.sol
the ONLY status that passes gate 2
Pending also fails gate 2 (DepositMintNotFailed): callback not delivered yet, or COTI keeps reverting and retrying (e.g. TokenNotRegistered before registration).
Success / Failed / SystemFailed are terminal (_setRequestStatus :628-637 allows them only from Pending). SystemFailed = the inbox rejected the message before the COTI app ran — not an app failure.
4 · Outcome matrix — escrow status (rows) × pToken status (columns)
Reachable in practice: only the “Pending” row. (Pending, None) cannot occur — the escrow key is the request id returned by mint(), which is written Pending in the same transaction.
